answer: The violet schedule is applied in opal and walnut makes public each instalment. Someone therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 27% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4553 identities would post 1185 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
